name: 16 Pro

images.credit: Rafael Fernandez, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.SIM: Dual eSIM (US), Dual nano-SIM (Hong Kong, Macau and mainland China), nano-SIM and eSIM (elsewhere)

Body.Other: Emergency SOS, Messages and Find My via satellite, FaceTime Audio or Video at 1080p over Wi-Fi and 5G, Voice over 5G Standalone (if supported by the carrier)

Memory.Storage: 128 GB (Pro only), 256 GB, 512 GB, 1 TB, NVMe

Display.Display: 16 Pro: 6.3 in resolution at up to 120 hz, 16 Pro Max: 6.9 in resolution at up to 120 hz

Cameras.Rear camera: 48 MP, 1.8, 24mm (wide), 12 MP, 2.8, 120mm (periscope telephoto), 48 MP, 2.2, 13mm (ultrawide), TOF 3D LiDAR scanner

Battery.Battery: 16 Pro: 13.94 Wh (3582 mAh) Lithium-ion, Li-ion @ 3.89 V, 16 Pro Max: 18.17 Wh (4685 mAh) Li-ion @ 3.88 V
Battery.Charging: MagSafe (wireless charger), MagSafe and Qi2 wireless charging, USB-C, (fast-charge capable: up to 50% charge in 30 minutes with 20W adaptor or higher), (Up to 50% charge in 20 minutes with 40W adaptor or higher)

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 7 tri-band, Bluetooth 5.3 (A2DP, LE), Ultra-wideband, Thread, NFC (reader mode, Express Cards), LEO satellite (Globalstar, limited), USB-C: USB 10Gbps, Dual-frequency GPS (L1, L5), GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS, BeiDou, NavIC
